info.name: Songbook
info.summary: A shared ChordPro songbook for bands
info.description: Songbook is a native Nextcloud app for a band's shared song library and setlists. This development version supports shared folder libraries, ChordPro import and export, indexed search, chord sheets and an editor with live preview and conflict-checked saving. Shared setlists support ordered song references, per-position notes and conflict-checked editing.
info.author: Songbook contributors
